environment.description: ECS Fargate task running identical container image msg-processor:2.4.1 on platform version 1.4.0. Task role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/msg-processor-staging has network access to internal services. Split.io SDK configured with workspace 'msg-platform', environment key 'staging-controlled'. The treatment for split 'msg-transform-legacy-path' is configured with default treatment 'off' and the definition has zero targeting rules (empty conditions array) with default rule returning 'off' treatment. SDK initialization uses 'localhost' mode fallback with YAML file /etc/splits/overrides.yaml containing only entry 'msg-transform-legacy-path: off'. The Split relay proxy at split-relay.internal:3141 serves pre-computed evaluations from a read-only Redis cache that was seeded with treatment=off. Container task networking uses awsvpc mode with security group sg-0a8f3c that has NO egress rule to Split.io CDN endpoints (cdn.split.io, events.split.io, streaming.split.io) ensuring SDK cannot fetch remote definitions and falls back to localhost mode with the hardcoded 'off' YAML. Additionally, the ECS task definition includes environment variable SPLIT_FEATURE_FLAG_CACHE_ONLY=true which the application SDK wrapper interprets as 'never fetch remote, use local cache exclusively'.

config.security_group_egress: no egress to cdn.split.io, events.split.io, streaming.split.io
